collection.title: Santana PS10 2004 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Santana PS10 2004 to 2007 model which requires a 13" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 13" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
